cases.expected: non‑null JsonSchema instance whose meta‑schema is the default draft‑7 and which validates a simple object correctly
cases.description: Happy‑path: a well‑formed JSON schema string with a default (empty) configuration should be parsed and a JsonSchema object returned.

cases.expected: non‑null JsonSchema instance that respects the supplied config (e.g., fail‑fast mode is enabled)
cases.description: Verify that a custom `SchemaValidatorsConfig` is propagated to the created schema.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException (or NullPointerException) indicating that the schema string must not be null
cases.description: Calling `getSchema` with a `null` schema string should result in an exception rather than a silent failure.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException stating that the schema string is empty or blank
cases.description: An empty string cannot be parsed as a JSON schema; the method should reject it early.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException (or a parsing exception) because the schema contains an unknown type
cases.description: Invalid JSON schema content should cause a parsing/validation exception.

cases.expected: non‑null JsonSchema instance with the $ref correctly resolved
cases.description: Schema containing an internal `$ref` should be resolved during loading; the returned schema must be usable.

cases.expected: non‑null JsonSchema instance using the factory's default configuration
cases.description: When `config` is `null` the method should fall back to the factory's default `SchemaValidatorsConfig` rather than throwing NPE.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException (or IOException) because the default input format is JSON but the content is YAML
cases.description: The overload called defaults to `InputFormat.JSON`; providing YAML content should trigger a parsing error.

cases.expected: non‑null JsonSchema instance whose meta‑schema is Draft‑04 (the `$schema` keyword is honoured) and that validates an object with an integer `id` correctly
cases.description: Schema explicitly declares Draft‑04 via `$schema`; the factory must load the corresponding meta‑schema and associate it with the returned JsonSchema.

cases.expected: non‑null JsonSchema instance that always validates (i.e., `validate` never reports errors) because the schema is the boolean `true` per the JSON‑Schema spec
cases.description: A boolean schema `true` is a valid JSON‑Schema that matches any instance; the method should accept it and produce a permissive JsonSchema.

cases.expected: non‑null JsonSchema instance that always fails validation (i.e., `validate` always returns an error) because the schema is the boolean `false`
cases.description: A boolean schema `false` is a valid JSON‑Schema that matches no instance; the factory must return a JsonSchema that rejects everything.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException (or a subclass) indicating that the external `$ref` could not be resolved
cases.description: External `$ref` pointing to a non‑existent URI should cause schema loading to fail with a clear exception.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException (or a specific cyclic‑reference exception) because the schema contains a cyclic `$ref` that cannot be resolved
cases.description: Detect and report a cyclic reference within the same document; the factory must not enter an infinite loop.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException (or IOException) caused by malformed JSON (missing comma between fields)
cases.description: Invalid JSON syntax should be caught during parsing and reported as a schema‑loading exception.

cases.expected: non‑null JsonSchema instance; the leading UTF‑8 BOM is ignored and the schema is parsed successfully
cases.description: A schema string that starts with a Unicode Byte Order Mark should still be accepted.

cases.expected: non‑null JsonSchema instance where the `$ref` resolves to the local definition via the base URI derived from `$id`
cases.description: Tests proper handling of `$id` and relative `$ref` resolution within the same document.

cases.expected: non‑null JsonSchema instance that validates a value if it is either a string or an integer
cases.description: Schema using the `anyOf` combinator should be loaded without error; the resulting JsonSchema must correctly apply the combinator semantics.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException indicating that the `$schema` URI refers to an unknown or unsupported meta‑schema version
cases.description: The `$schema` keyword points to a draft version that the factory does not recognise; loading should fail with a clear exception.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException (or URISyntaxException) caused by an invalid URI in `$id`
cases.description: A malformed URI in the `$id` keyword should be detected early and result in an exception rather than an undefined behavior.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException because the top‑level schema is a JSON array; only an object or boolean is allowed
cases.description: The JSON Schema specification requires the root schema to be an object or a boolean. Supplying an array must be rejected.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException indicating that the referenced document is not a valid JSON Schema
cases.description: An external `$ref` that resolves to a JSON document which is not a schema should cause loading to fail.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException caused by a malformed JSON‑Pointer fragment in the `$ref` value
cases.description: The `$ref` contains an illegal escape sequence (`~` not followed by `0` or `1`), which must be detected and reported.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException stating that the schema string is blank or contains only whitespace
cases.description: A string that consists solely of whitespace cannot be parsed as a JSON Schema and should be rejected up‑front.
